newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel says PFLP responsible for attack.
newsitem.headline: Israel says PFLP responsible for attack.

text.p: Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai said on Wednesday that militants of George Habash's Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine (PFLP) killed two Jewish settlers in the West Bank.

"We know that those who carried out the attack were from the PFLP," Mordechai told a news conference at the West Bank Jewish settlement of Beit El, near where Wednesday's drive-by shooting occurred. Mordechai did not immediately elaborate.
The Israeli dead were a mother and her 12-year-old son, Israeli police and hospital officials said. Five other members of the family were wounded.
The family came under fire in their car by Arab gunmen from a passing vehicle near the Jewish settlement of Beit El outside Ramallah, Israeli security sources said.

They said the attackers fled toward Ramallah. Israeli troops in coordination with Palestinian police had entered Ramallah to investigate an abandoned, torched car which fitted the description of the attackers' vehicle, Israel and the PLO said.

Wednesday was the anniversary of the founding of the PFLP in 1968. The PFLP along with Islamic movements Hamas and Islamic Jihad, opposes the Palestine Liberation Organisation's interim peace deal with Israel as a sell-out of the Palestinian cause.
